notes: Small FastAPI + SQLModel backend. Python runtime reaches three external services: PostgreSQL (psycopg via SQLAlchemy/SQLModel, also Alembic), an SMTP server (emails library; dev default Mailpit via compose.override.yml / .env localhost:1025), and Sentry (optional via SENTRY_DSN). The TypeScript frontend only calls the repo's own backend; Mailpit's HTTP API is used only by Playwright TS tests. Unsure about SMTP canonical naming (protocol-level 'smtp/email' chosen since host is fully configurable) and its hosting (self-hosted based on shipped dev default; production may be a cloud SMTP provider).
